changes.to: No maker product page exists. Svaya's own site (svayarobotics.com, checked 2026-11-17) presents only collaborative and humanoid robots and has no quadruped page; the robot is known from the company's March 2023 release, reported by The Hindu, that it was developed with DRDO labs R&DE and DEBEL as a technology demonstrator with design inputs from R&DE, for remote reconnaissance and inspection where it is unsafe for people to operate. No mass, dimension, speed, payload or battery figure has been published by Svaya, so every spec field stays empty.
Quadruped technology demonstrator built by Svaya Robotics with DRDO's R&DE (Pune) for reconnaissance and inspection in unstructured terrain for defence and security forces.
